name: Train Booking Refund Receipt
description: Receipt email sent when a train ticket refund is processed
subject: Refund Receipt - Train Booking #{booking_id}
body_html:
Refund Receipt

Dear {customer_name},

Your refund has been processed successfully.

Refund Details

Booking ID:#{booking_id}
Refund Amount:£{refund_amount}
Refund Date:{refund_date}
Original Payment Method:{payment_method}
Refund Reference:{refund_id}

Note: The refund will be credited to your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

Thank you for using our service.

Best regards,
Train Service

customer_name.description: Name of the customer receiving the refund
